title: Personal NOC, SOC & Life Incident Response Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:score) OR (index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:service)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="lifeos:score","primary",sourcetype="lifeos:service","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from lifeos:score and lifeos:service to see whether two personal noc, soc feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `lifeos:score` and `lifeos:service` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main personal noc, soc data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
